summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns for share buybacks conducted on June 8-10, 2026. On June 8, the company repurchased 1,572,000 ordinary shares at HKD 25.4391 per share, representing 0.1269% of existing issued shares. The shares were bought for cancellation but not yet cancelled as of the closing balance date. This is an on-market capital return program via an issuer tender. The filing confirms compliance with Hong Kong listing rules and board authorization. The number of issued shares remained unchanged at 1,238,960,393. Watch for continued buyback activity and share cancellation timeline.
